relations.statement: The zero effect is an effect in the ordered effect unit.
The unit of the ordered effect unit is an effect.
effect_zero and effect_u form the boundary of the ordered effect unit used to license the Kraus diagonal bounds in ExactKrausChannel.
Compose diagnostic f64 channel with exact Kraus admission using zero and unit effects.
floating-point parameters in quantum_channel.rs cannot admit a channel; exact admission requires ExactKrausChannel with rational Kraus operators.
Ground the exact channel admission for one weighted Kraus operator Q(i) in the split between diagnostic and exact faces.

open_obligations: ExactKrausChannel admission for weighted single-qubit channel Q(i) with rational Kraus operators
